The '''2025–26 season''' was [[Al-Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]]'s 50th consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Saudi Arabia|Saudi football]] and 70th year in existence as a [[Football club (association football)|football club]].<ref>{{cite web |title=عن النادي |url=https://alnassr.sa/ar/about |access-date=3 June 2023 |archive-date=10 June 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220610063706/https://alnassr.sa/ar/about |url-status=dead }}</ref> The club participated in the [[2025–26 Saudi Pro League|Pro League]], the [[2025–26 King's Cup (Saudi Arabia)|King's Cup]], the [[2025–26 AFC Champions League Two|AFC Champions League Two]], and the [[2025 Saudi Super Cup|Super Cup]]. 

On 21 May 2026, Al-Nassr were officially crowned champions of the [[2025–26 Saudi Pro League]] after an 4–1 home win against [[Damac Club|Damac]] on the final matchday. This was their 11th league title in the club's history, and their first since the [[2018–19 Saudi Pro League|2018–19 season]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Cristiano Ronaldo double fires Al Nassr to 2025-26 RSL title glory|url=https://www.spl.com.sa/en/news/1069609/ronaldo-double-fires-al-nassr-to-2025-26-rsl-title-glory|date=21 May 2026|access-date=22 May 2026|website=spl.com.sa}}</ref>

==Overview==
On 2 June 2025, Al-Nassr made their first signing when they signed young midfielder [[Abdulmalik Al-Jaber]]. [[Ali Lajami]] joined rivals [[Al Hilal SFC|Al-Hilal]] on a free transfer on 27 May. On 6 July 2025, [[Jhon Durán]] was loaned to [[Süper Lig]] club [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=7 July 2025|title=Duran joins Fenerbahce on loan from Al-Nassr|url= https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/ckg69070dpyo|access-date=17 July 2025|website=BBC|language=en}}</ref>

This season saw the appointment of a new head coach [[Jorge Jesus]] on 14 July 2025 after the termination of [[Stefano Pioli]]'s contract.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-07-14 |title=Jorge Jesus returns to Saudi Pro League with Al-Nassr |url=https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2608089/sport |access-date=2025-07-17 |website=Arab News |language=en}}</ref> Al-Nassr signed [[Nader Al-Sharari]] on a free transfer on 16 July 2025. Al-Nassr signed [[João Félix]] from [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] and [[Iñigo Martínez]] from [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] on 29 July and 9 August respectively.
